programs.description: A special agent investigates a murder committed by a masked group of serial killers. However, a tangled maze of clues soon leads him to the drug kingpin of Chennai.

programs.showName: Marakkar: Lion of the Arabian Sea
programs.description: Kunjali Marakkar IV, a fearless naval commander, rises against Portuguese tyranny. With courage and cunning, he leads a legendary resistance, defending his people in a thunderous clash of empires.
A man is pulled into a plot to assassinate a chief minister at a political rally. However, he soon realises that he is trapped in a time loop with a police officer.
A businessman returns to his homeland to reconcile with his friend. Soon, upon learning of his friend's plight, he becomes a crusader for the farmers in the village.
After falling in love with Suchitra, Appu must go against the odds to win her over and marry her despite her father's disapproval of him.

Shivalinga, a poor laborer, fails to earn enough money to save his mother's life. Later, he rescues a kidnapped girl and, aiming to fund her education, joins the underworld, leading to chaotic events.
When Bramhavar, a kind man, is wrongly charged with murder, a lawyer comes to his rescue and determinedly strives to clear Bramhavar's name.
A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.
Three cousins, Divya, Krishnan and Arjuna, share a close bond and decide to move to Bangalore to fulfil their childhood dreams. There, they face challenges that will change their lives forever.
An intelligent and ambitious youngster arrives in Mumbai and becomes a mafia don, but one day, things take turn when he falls in love with a cop's daughter.
A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.
Surya and his sister Vidya are orphans who are often mistreated by local ruffians. Years later, Surya grows up and becomes an honest police officer and sets off to find the killers of his guardian.
Raghuchandra changes his identity in order to marry his cousin to settle the family conflict between his father and aunt.
When a taxi driver begins to experience various eerie events in his vehicle, he strives to uncover the truth behind the mysterious occurrences.
A bountiful and helpful boy falls in love with a musician without knowing the fact that a rich spoilt brat is also planning to woo her.
With limited evidence in a race against time, two police officers must combine their skills and experience to arrest a psychopath targeting women.
Satya slips into a coma after undergoing a face transplant after an accident where his face is damaged and his lover Deepthi dies. On waking up, he decides to avenge her death.
The grandson of a rich businessman promises to reunite him with his estranged daughter and enters their home in disguise. However, he has to deal with several challenges to keep his promise.

When he arrives in the city to earn a living, Yadhunandhan is helped by Mayakka, a gangster, who also gives him a place to live. When she is killed by a rival gang, Yadhunandhan decides to avenge her.
ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.
Shankar, a factory worker, is forced to marry his employer's daughter who is arrogant. He decides to teach her a lesson in order to make her realize her fault.
A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.
Krishna, an orphan medical student, lives a seemingly ordinary life. However, unbeknownst to people, he is a vigilante named Jaguar who pursues a certain group of people in order to kill them.
A man is pulled into a plot to assassinate a chief minister at a political rally. However, he soon realises that he is trapped in a time loop with a police officer.
Gurudev Hoysala, a morally upright police inspector, is transferred to Athani to investigate a fellow officer's disappearance. However, a suspicious young couple soon complicates the case.
A sportsman travelling to a village for a match saves a woman from a brutal factionist. The latter pursues them, but he refuses to back down from the confrontation, changing his life forever.
When Ravi unknowingly thwarts Bittu's bank heist, he becomes the target of Bittu's wrath. Subsequently, Ravi is forced to fight to protect his loved ones from the ruthless criminal.

Due to the demands of their students, a male student is admitted at an all-girls college. But new student Aditya, who dislikes studies, hopes that like in the past, this time too he will be suspended.
The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.
Two friends, Sanju and Anupama, fall in love with each other. However, they don't realise it, until it is too late and Anupama is set to marry someone else.
When Madakari, an honest police officer, gets murdered by some local thugs, his daughter is mysteriously left on the doorstep of his strange doppelgänger.
Inspired by Amitabh Bachchan's Don, a fan sets out to make a name for himself in the underworld. However, a case of mistaken identity may turn this endeavour into a comedy of errors.
Subramanyam, a money-minded man, comes across Seetha, a woman living alone in the US after being abandoned by her boyfriend. Subsequently, he decides to help her after seeing her plight.
Disowned by her parents, Ganga, a transgender woman, moves to the city where she struggles to lead a normal life. Subsequently, she encounters several tribulations due to discrimination.
Inspired by Amitabh Bachchan's Don, a fan sets out to make a name for himself in the underworld. However, a case of mistaken identity may turn this endeavour into a comedy of errors.
Veerabhadra, who loves his sister very much, gets her married to a nice man. However, when Veerabhadra's close friend is killed, he decides to wipe out anti-social elements in the city.
Jagan, a local travel guide, falls in love with Radha, a tourist who visits his city. Though she leaves without saying goodbye, fate conspires to bring them together again.
Kush reluctantly marries Khushi. However, things take a drastic turn when they both start getting to know each other and uncover the lies they fed one another.
Sultan, a motherless child, is raised by a group of criminals working for his father. However, when his father dies, he decides to reform the group into better people.
Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.
A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.
A man with fetal alcohol syndrome keeps himself alive by drinking a certain amount of alcohol. However, things change when he falls in love with a beautiful woman.
A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.
Two brothers live in harmony. However, their relationship soon begins to fall apart when the younger brother's wife starts creating clashes between them.
A cat and mouse chase ensues between Gaja and a rival faction leader over a few startling events. Gaja tries to protect his friend, Krishna, and his lover, Shwetha, who are being targeted.
On the verge of divorcing his wife, a man explains his unhappy life to the Almighty. God then offers him a second chance at a happy ending.
The life of Santhosh changes after Vijay, owner of a crime organisation called Gayakwad Syndicate, enlists his help in his business dealings.
After getting appointed as an inspector, Arun undertakes a mission to track down a notorious serial killer who targets teen girls.

When he arrives in the city to earn a living, Yadhunandhan is helped by Mayakka, a gangster, who also gives him a place to live. When she is killed by a rival gang, Yadhunandhan decides to avenge her.
Lakshminarayana, a CBI officer, is drawn into a dangerous conspiracy when his wife Priya vanishes after discovering hidden weapons, leading him on a mission that uncovers shocking truths.
After getting appointed as an inspector, Arun undertakes a mission to track down a notorious serial killer who targets teen girls.
Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.
Abhi, a college student in Bangalore, meets Bhanu who stays as a tenant in his house. Despite their differences, they fall in love, which soon sparks trouble in their lives.
Two friends escape from a mental asylum where they were wrongfully confined. Later, as one of them finds love, his dark past resurfaces and threatens their newfound peace.
An old couple sacrifices everything, so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.
A software engineer arrives in India to serve the nation and invest in the country's welfare but a few evil and corrupt politicians try to stop him.
